items.item:
- TXN-001, TXN-002: the transaction guard check
  [witness: verification:transaction_guard_client_portal].
statements:
TXN-001: no transaction is rolled back twice, rolled back after a commit,
  or left open.

TXN-002: a domain error raised inside a guarded transaction reaches the
  caller unchanged, never masked by a persistence error of the closed
  transaction.

verdicts.item:
- TXN-001, TXN-002: the transaction guard check
  [witness: verification:transaction_guard_client_portal].
statements:
TXN-001: no transaction is rolled back twice, rolled back after a commit,
  or left open.

TXN-002: a domain error raised inside a guarded transaction reaches the
  caller unchanged, never masked by a persistence error of the closed
  transaction.
quotes: assert events, f"{scenario}: transaction {index} was never closed"
except PersistenceError as error:  # pragma: no cover - the regression itself
raise AssertionError(f"{scenario}: expected {expected.__name__}, nothing was raised")
verdicts.why: The check detects transactions left open or closed more than once and verifies commit/rollback outcomes on exercised success paths; it also detects a PersistenceError masking an expected domain-error type. It does not establish that the original domain-error object reaches the caller unchanged, because it only matches the expected exception type and does not check object identity or contents.
